mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rbac_authorization_authority(user_id,source,version,updated_at) SELECT u.id,'LEGACY',#{version},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM user_profile u ORDER BY u.id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=rbac_authorization_authority.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rbac_authorization_authority WHERE source='LEGACY' AND version=#{version}

SELECT COUNT(*) users,COALESCE(SUM(a.user_id IS NULL),0) missing, COALESCE(SUM(a.source='LEGACY'),0) legacy,COALESCE(SUM(a.source='ASSIGNMENT'),0) assignment, COALESCE(SUM(a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (a.source NOT IN ('LEGACY','ASSIGNMENT') OR a.version NOT REGEXP '[^[:space:]]')),0) corrupt FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN rbac_authorization_authority a ON a.user_id=u.id
SELECT UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
SELECT u.id user_id,u.status,u.role legacy_role,u.ban_expire_at,u.deleted_at,a.source,a.version FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN rbac_authorization_authority a ON a.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id=#{userId}

SELECT u.id user_id,u.status,u.ban_expire_at,u.deleted_at,a.source,a.version FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN rbac_authorization_authority a ON a.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id IN
#{u}

SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*),':', BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(d,1,16),16,10) AS UNSIGNED)),':', BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(d,17,16),16,10) AS UNSIGNED)),':', BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(d,33,16),16,10) AS UNSIGNED)),':', BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(d,49,16),16,10) AS UNSIGNED))) FROM (SELECT SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(u.id,u.profile_revision,u.session_version,u.status,u.ban_expire_at,u.deleted_at,a.source,a.version) AS CHAR),256) d FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN rbac_authorization_authority a ON a.user_id=u.id) directory

SELECT u.id user_id,u.status,u.role legacy_role,u.ban_expire_at,u.deleted_at,a.source,a.version FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN rbac_authorization_authority a ON a.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT code,namespaces,lifecycle,readiness,grantable,unavailable_reason,catalog_digest FROM rbac_permission_definition ORDER BY code
SELECT code,namespaces,lifecycle,readiness,grantable,unavailable_reason,catalog_digest FROM rbac_role ORDER BY code
SELECT role_code,permission_code FROM rbac_role_permission ORDER BY role_code,permission_code

choose.when: SELECT #{assignments[0].id} requested_id,#{assignments[0].grantChangeId} requested_grant_id, e.id effect_id,e.user_id,e.assignment_id,e.before_snapshot,e.after_snapshot, o.id operation_id,o.kind,o.snapshot_version,o.receipt,o.occurred_at FROM rbac_offline_effect e LEFT JOIN rbac_offline_operation o ON o.id=e.operation_id WHERE e.assignment_id=#{assignments[0].id} OR e.id=#{assignments[0].grantChangeId} UNION ALL SELECT #{assignments[0].id},#{assignments[0].grantChangeId},NULL,NULL,j.assignment_id,NULL,NULL, o.id,o.kind,o.snapshot_version,o.receipt,o.occurred_at FROM rbac_offline_operation o JOIN JSON_TABLE(o.receipt,'$.effects[*]' COLUMNS(assignment_id VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.assignmentId' NULL ON EMPTY)) j WHERE j.assignment_id=#{assignments[0].id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rbac_offline_effect e WHERE e.assignment_id=#{assignments[0].id})

mapper.update: UPDATE rbac_user_role_assignment SET current_slot=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND current_slot=1 AND expires_at <= #{now}

UPDATE rbac_user_role_assignment SET revoked_at=#{now},revoke_change_id=#{changeId},version=#{nextVersion},current_slot=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})
UPDATE rbac_authorization_authority SET version=#{nextVersion},updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source='ASSIGNMENT' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,operation_id,actor_user_id,target_user_id,assignment_id,action,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,reason,snapshot_version, before_snapshot,after_snapshot,receipt,occurred_at FROM rbac_authorization_change WHERE actor_user_id=#{actor} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
